purpose: Approved TFS narrator re-styled as a history storyteller (Bryce, 2026-11-24: use our current TFS voice and design it into a storyteller). Only voice source: our own synthetic master clip.

sentences.text: Marso, labinlimang daan at dalawampu't isa.
Tatlong barko ang dumaong sa isla ng Homonhon.
Hindi alam ng mga tao roon na magbabago ang buong kapuluan, magpakailanman.
Pitong libong isla, mahigit isandaang wika, at tatlong siglong pamamahala ng iisang korona.
Pero may mga taong ayaw sumuko.

styles.R1: calm documentary storyteller, slow and measured, warm, falling intonation at the end of each sentence
styles.R2: cinematic history narrator, grave and dramatic, slow, with weight on key words
styles.R3: intimate storyteller telling a legend, soft and patient, slow, quiet intensity
styles.R4: epic documentary narration, rich and resonant, deliberate pace, rising tension then release
